navaids.name: University of Alaska Wave Data Lighted Buoy YB-2
navaids.description: Vessels are requested not to pass between this wave buoy, YB-2 and nearby wave buoy YB-1. There is a submerged line 6" to 36" below the surface that runs between the two buoys
